Subject: MAP & next steps — Aurelia Systems (post-demo) / pricing approval ask

Hi Claire / Maya,

Thanks again for the demo time this morning — appreciate the candid product questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timing:

1) Draft MAP (attached): milestone table with owners and dates (delivery POC, security review, procurement signature).
2) Target close: customer requested end-of-January — proposed target close 2027-01-31.
3) Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, procurement timeline, and a confirmed committed token band for pricing.
4) Ask for Redwood exec review: we need sign-off on a pricing exception (discount + one-time credit) to meet their procurement hurdles.

Ben is copying the MAP draft and term sheet; Marissa / Marcus, can you advise on discount/credit guardrails we should propose?

Next steps: Ben to share MAP v1 + term sheet (today). Claire / Maya, can you confirm procurement and legal contacts so we can loop them into the MAP?

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

- Please include the expected committed monthly token volume with each pricing option. Procurement needs explicit bands for the internal finance model.
- We need SOC2 artefacts (or a high-level summary) to share with our security team ahead of the procurement call.

Can you send the MAP draft and term sheet today so I can start internal routing?

Subject: Aurelia MAP v1 + pricing options (attached)

Claire / Maya — attaching: Aurelia_MAP_v1.pdf, Aurelia_security_summary.pdf, TermSheet_Redwood_Aurelia_v1.docx. Highlights:

- MAP milestones (owner / target):
  * Milestone 1 — POC environment access (Aurelia procures dev keys): Target 2026-12-30 — Owner: Aurelia
  * Milestone 2 — Security review complete (deliver SOC summary & control Q&A): Target 2027-01-10 — Owner: Redwood SecOps
  * Milestone 3 — Procurement & contract execution: Target 2027-01-31 — Owner: Aurelia Legal / Redwood Legal
  * Milestone 4 — Production onboarding & SLA sign-off: Target 2027-02-14 — Owner: Redwood CS / Aurelia Eng

- Pricing (summary):
  Option A — No commit (pay-as-you-go): base price, no one-time credit.
  Option B — 12-month committed band (>= 12M tokens/month): 20% list discount + $50,000 one-time credit (upfront applied to first invoice).
  Option C — 18-month higher-commit band (>= 18M tokens/month): 22% discount + $75,000 credit.

Ben's note: price options are proposed for internal exec review. We expect procurement to push on lower up-front credits; also legal will want to review indemnity/SLA language.

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v1.pdf; Aurelia_security_summary.pdf; TermSheet_Redwood_Aurelia_v1.docx

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia MAP v1 + pricing options (attached)

Thanks for the draft, Ben — clear and thorough. A couple of internal notes before we send a formal pricing ask to Aurelia:

- The 22% / $75k combination feels outside our standard SR thresholds for a first-time mid-market logo. Recommend we avoid the top-tier option unless there's a firm 24-month procurement commit.
- Proposed internal compromise: authorize up to 15% discount + $30k one-time credit for a 12-month commit at >= 15M tokens/month. We can then offer a stretch (18-month / 20% + $50k) only if legal signs off quickly.
- Need to confirm that CS will accept the onboarding timeline and any SLA exceptions.

Ben / Tessa — please rework the term sheet to include the 15%/ $30k option and show the stretch tier as a negotiable add-on. Marcus — tagging you for final exec clearance if we exceed 20% discount or $50k credit.

-Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T11:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia MAP v1 + pricing options (attached)

Quick decision from exec desk:

- Approve a concession path that the field can use to close by 2027-01-31. Final authorized proposal: 15% discount + $35,000 one-time credit for a 12-month commit >= 15M tokens/month.
- We will allow escalation to 20% / up to $50k credit only if legal or security requires additional contractual commitments (e.g., SLA penalty language) AND I sign off after seeing redlines.
- Condition: SOC2 summary must be delivered prior to procurement signature and standard Redwood SLA (with minimal edits) must be accepted.

Ben/Tessa: proceed to send the revised MAP/term sheet that reflects the 15% / $35k offer and call out the escalation path. Push procurement sync next week (Dec 23) to keep timeline tight.

Marcus Lin
VP, Global Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Park <claire.park@aurelia-sys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Aurelia MAP v1 + pricing options (attached)

Team — appreciate the fast turnaround and clarity. The 15% + $35k credit for 12 months at >=15M tokens/month is acceptable in principle. A few items before we mark target close:

- Please send the updated MAP and term sheet reflecting the new numbers and the conditional escalation path.
- We will run procurement/legal review on Dec 23; Maya will coordinate time for a short sync (we propose Dec 23 at 10:00 PT).
- We still need the SOC2 summary for our security team before legal signs. The Aurelia security checklist should be closed by 2027-01-10 per the MAP or we push the procurement milestone.

If you can get the revised materials in the next 24 hours we will start internal routing immediately.

Thanks — Claire
